#add a column with abbreviation for cell types to make plot more readable
add_abbreviation_column <- function(data, from_col, to_col = "abbr",default = "OTHER") {

  from_col_sym <- ensym(from_col)
  
  conditions <- purrr::map2(
    GemmaCellTypes, GemmaAbbreviations,
    ~ expr((!!from_col_sym) == !!.x ~ !!.y))
  
  conditions <- append(conditions, expr(TRUE ~ !!default))
  
  data %>%
    mutate(!!to_col := case_when(!!!conditions))
}

#filtering out cells that have matching gemma and author annotations
mismatchFilter <- function(df) {
  df %>% filter(
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Astro" & df$cell_type.y == "astrocyte") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Oligo" & df$cell_type.y == "oligodendrocyte") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Chandelier" & df$cell_type.y == "chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Endo" & df$cell_type.y == "endothelial cell") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "L5_ET" & df$cell_type.y == "L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "L2/3_IT" & df$cell_type.y == "L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron") & #L2/3-6 is more broad?
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Lamp5" & df$cell_type.y == "lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "OPC" & df$cell_type.y == "oligodendrocyte precursor cell") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Vip" & df$cell_type.y == "vip GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Sst" & df$cell_type.y == "sst GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Sncg" & df$cell_type.y == "sncg GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Pvalb" & df$cell_type.y == "pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "L6b" & df$cell_type.y == "L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "L6_CT" & df$cell_type.y == "L6 corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "Micro" & df$cell_type.y == "microglial cell") &
    !(df$cell_type.x == "VLMC" & df$cell_type.y == "vascular leptomeningeal cell")
  )
}

matchFilter <- function(df) {
  df %>% filter(
    (df$cell_type.x == "Astro" & df$cell_type.y == "astrocyte") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Oligo" & df$cell_type.y == "oligodendrocyte") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Chandelier" & df$cell_type.y == "chandelier pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Endo" & df$cell_type.y == "endothelial cell") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "L5_ET" & df$cell_type.y == "L5 extratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "L2/3_IT" & df$cell_type.y == "L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Lamp5" & df$cell_type.y == "lamp5 GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "OPC" & df$cell_type.y == "oligodendrocyte precursor cell") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Vip" & df$cell_type.y == "vip GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Sst" & df$cell_type.y == "sst GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Sncg" & df$cell_type.y == "sncg GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Pvalb" & df$cell_type.y == "pvalb GABAergic cortical interneuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "L6b" & df$cell_type.y == "L6b glutamatergic cortical neuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "L6_CT" & df$cell_type.y == "L6 corticothalamic-projecting glutamatergic cortical neuron") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "Micro" & df$cell_type.y == "microglial cell") |
    (df$cell_type.x == "VLMC" & df$cell_type.y == "vascular leptomeningeal cell")
  )
}

#renaming columns to make less confusing and remove author cell type URI column since it's empty
columnRename <- function(df){
  colNames <- c(sample_id.x = "author_sample_id",
    cell_id = "cell_id",
    cell_type.x = "author_cell_type",
    cell_type_uri.x = "author_cell_type_uri",
    sample_id.y = "gemma_sample_id",
    cell_type.y = "gemma_cell_type",
    cell_type_uri.y = "gemma_cell_type_uri")
  rename(df, colNames) %>%
  select(cell_id, everything(), -author_cell_type_uri) 
}

cellCountPlot <- function(df, plotTitle, type_col, angle, ylim){
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = type_col, fill = type_col)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label= ..count..), 
            vjust=-0.3, 
            color = "black", 
            size = 2.5,) +
  labs(
    title = plotTitle,
    x = "cell types",
    y = "Count") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, ylim),
      labels = label_comma(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
     theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = angle, hjust = 1))
  
}

# Counts of Gemma cell type annotations vs. author cell type annotations

## CMC

```{r}

CMCGemma <- add_abbreviation_column(CMCGemma, cell_type, to_col = "abbr")

cellCountPlot(CMCGemma, "CMC Gemma Annotations", CMCGemma$abbr, 17, 200500)

cellCountPlot(CMCAuthor, "CMC Author Annotations", CMCAuthor$cell_type, 45, 200500)

```
```{r}
#mismatches

CMCMismatch <- left_join(CMCAuthor, CMCGemma, by = "cell_id") %>%
 mismatchFilter() %>% columnRename()
  

cellCountPlot(CMCMismatch, "Gemma Cell Types Annotated differently from Author Cell Types", CMCMismatch$abbr, 17, 110000)
cellCountPlot(CMCMismatch, "Author Cell Types Annotated differently from Gemma Cell Types", CMCMismatch$author_cell_type, 45, 110000)

#matches

CMCMatch <- left_join(CMCAuthor, CMCGemma, by = "cell_id") %>%
 matchFilter() %>% columnRename()

cellCountPlot(CMCMatch, "Matching Gemma and author cell types", CMCMatch$author_cell_type, 25, 110000)

CMCL23 <- subset(CMCMismatch, gemma_cell_type == "L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neuron")

cellCountPlot(CMCL23, "Mismatched author annotations of Gemma-annotated L2/3-6 intratelencephalic projecting glutamatergic neurons", CMCL23$author_cell_type, 25, 40000)

```
